Dear ImGui 1.93.0 WIP, vendored as a full upstream tree (no submodule, so `git clone`
alone builds). 304 files, 8.5 MB; only imgui*.cpp plus the GLFW and OpenGL 3 backend
are compiled — the rest is upstream's own examples/docs, kept verbatim so the pin is
auditable.

Upstream: https://github.com/ocornut/imgui
Pinned at commit 4989b4c75491f2908aa3072ed3041245e6f98c09 (2026-10-05).
License: MIT, see vendor/imgui/LICENSE.txt.

To update: re-clone upstream at the new commit, replace this tree, then re-run
`sh Tools/make_bundle.sh` and one `./build/pin_imgui_shell --dump` round to confirm
the panel still renders.
